test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What historic achievement did Manu Bhaker accomplish at the 2024 Paris Olympics?

options.text: First Indian to win an Olympic medal in shooting
First athlete to win medals in both individual and team events
First Indian female shooter to win an Olympic gold
First athlete of independent India to win two Olympic medals in a single edition

solution:
The correct answer is __**First athlete of independent India to win two Olympic medals in a single edition**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Manu Bhaker became the **first athlete of independent India to win two Olympic medals in a single edition** at the 2024 Paris Olympics.
 
• She achieved this historic feat by securing medals in both the individual women's 10m air pistol event and the mixed team 10m air pistol event.
 
• This landmark achievement marks a significant milestone in India's Olympic history, showcasing her exceptional talent and dedication.
 
• Manu Bhaker's performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics has inspired many young athletes in the country to pursue their dreams in sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Olympic Shooting Events:**

 
 
• Shooting events in the Olympics are divided into rifle, pistol, and shotgun categories.
 
• Competitors aim to hit targets with precision to score points, with the highest scores winning medals.
 
• Events are held for both men and women, individually and in teams.
 
 
 
• **10m Air Pistol:**
 
 
• This is a precision shooting event where competitors shoot at a target 10 meters away.
 
• It involves shooting 60 shots within a time limit, and the highest total score determines the winner.
